# Using Video to Skill in Cline

<!-- Generated by `node packages/cli build` from the harness registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

The skill is the same in every agent. This guide covers only what is specific to Cline.

## Install

Project scope (one repository): copy this skill folder to `.cline/skills/video-to-skill/`.

User scope (every project): copy it to `~/.cline/skills/video-to-skill/`.

From the gti-skills repository, the CLI does the copy for you:

```bash
node packages/cli install --harness cline --skill video-to-skill
node packages/cli install --harness cline --skill video-to-skill --scope user
```

Restart the agent session after installing so it rescans its skills.

## Use

Describe the task in plain language. Cline loads the skill when the request matches its `description`. You can also run it explicitly by typing `/video-to-skill`.

## Where the skill finds its files

`<skill-dir>` in `SKILL.md` is the folder that contains `SKILL.md`: `.cline/skills/video-to-skill` for a project install, or `~/.cline/skills/video-to-skill` for a user install. Scripts and references are always addressed relative to it.

## Verify

Open the Skills tab in the Cline panel to see and toggle installed skills.

## Notes

- The name field must match the folder name exactly.
- Documentation: [Cline](https://docs.cline.bot/customization/skills) (path source: official).
